property_summary: For any admissible short order, a successful fillOrder must record the caller's position expiration as positionExpirations[positionId] == block.timestamp + duration (a nonzero value); the mutant never writes the mapping, so the recorded expiration stays 0 for any positive duration.
change_summary: Delete the assignment that stores the position expiration, so positionExpirations is never set in fillOrder.
